fullPassage: In the late 1960s, the art world was divided into so many minor movements that tracking them all is difficult. In one of the most radical of these movements, artists believed that they didn't need to produce any artwork at all (rather like Dada) but simply generate concepts or ideas. In reality, this conceptual art, as it's known, is often a type of performance or "happening" that can be very spontaneous and audience-driven. Sometimes it's simply writing on a wall. One early conceptual artist camped out with a coyote for a week in an art gallery to get people thinking about the treatment of Native Americans. Feminist art is linked with conceptual art in that it focuses on the inequalities faced by women and tries to provoke change. The movement has no set style. It might include a painting on canvas or a group of women dressed up in gorilla costumes crashing a public event to pass out pamphlets.

In reality, this conceptual art, as it's ③<u>known</u>, is often a type of performance or "happening" that can be very spontaneous and audience-driven. Sometimes it's simply writing on a wall. One early conceptual artist camped out with a coyote for a week in an art gallery to get people thinking about the treatment of Native Americans. Feminist art is linked with conceptual art in that it focuses on the inequalities ④<u>faced</u> by women and tries to provoke change. The movement has no set style. It might include a painting on canvas or a group of women dressed up in gorilla costumes crashing a public event to pass out pamphlets.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① dividing → divided: the art world was divided에서 be + p.p. 수동태.
det.analysis:
❌ ① dividing → divided (the art world was divided: be + p.p. 수동태. dividing은 능동) ←정답
✅ ② believed: artists believed — 과거시제 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ known: as it's known — 수동 과거분사 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ faced: inequalities faced by women — 수동 과거분사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: was divided: 미술계가 '나뉘어진' 것. 수동태(be + p.p.). dividing은 능동으로 비문.
